meaning:
αἴνεσις, -εως, ἡ
(αἰνέω), [in LXX chiefly for תּוֹדָה, תְּהִלָּה ;]
praise (Eccl.): θυσία αἰνέσεως (Lev.7:12, זֶבַח תּוֹדָה), Heb.13:15.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
